title: Pumpkin: modeled ₹425/qtl left, Pampady → Thrippunithura
summary: February 2023: reported pumpkin prices at Pampady and Thrippunithura imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 86% of 21 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹425 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 348 same-variety market pairs screened for pumpkin in February 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Thrippunithura report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: February 2023
scenes.caption: Pampady (Kerala) and Thrippunithura (Kerala) both reported pumpkin prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 21 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Pampady reported a median ₹1,700 per quintal. Thrippunithura reported a median ₹2,400 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹500/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹500 per quintal, and Thrippunithura was dearer on 90% of days.

scenes.headline: 64 km by road
scenes.caption: 64 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~1 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹14/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹277 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹163 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Thrippunithura report, the rule selects 17 of 21 modeled shipping days. 15 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹425 per quintal (₹299 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pumpkin route from Pampady to Thrippunithura was positive on 86% of matched days in February 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹42,500, or ₹29,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹14/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pumpkin route from Pampady to Thrippunithura was positive on 86% of matched days in February 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹42,500, or ₹29,900 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Pumpkin: modeled ₹367/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: November 2023: reported pumpkin prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 89% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹367 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 396 same-variety market pairs screened for pumpkin in November 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: November 2023
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported pumpkin prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 19 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹1,250 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹1,825 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹550/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹550 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 150 km by road
scenes.caption: 150 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~3 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹32/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹358 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹262 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Kangra (Baijnath) report, the rule selects 18 of 19 modeled shipping days. 17 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹367 per quintal (₹267 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pumpkin route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 89% of matched days in November 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,700, or ₹26,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pumpkin
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹32/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pumpkin route from Dhanotu (Mandi) to Kangra (Baijnath) was positive on 89% of matched days in November 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹36,700, or ₹26,700 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
